# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want every Bug audited, so that a closed Bug proves it was fixed rather than recording that somebody said so

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** every Bug on this board audited
**So that** a closed Bug proves it was actually fixed, instead of recording that somebody said so

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given each of the 13 bugs, when it is read, then it matches the bug
      template: Bug, Root Cause, Severity vs. Priority, criteria, Notes
      (`audit-check.py 312 --tree`)
- [ ] Given each bug's "Fixed and verified live" criterion, when it is
      checked, then it names the test or command that proves the fix, and
      none closes on a date alone (`audit-check.py 312 --tree`)
- [ ] Given each bug's "Regression test added" criterion, when it is
      checked, then that test exists, runs in CI, and fails if the bug is
      reintroduced (named per bug in #313, #314 and #315, each observed
      failing before passing)
- [ ] Given each bug, when its metadata is read, then Severity and Priority
      are set independently and the priority label matches the body
      (`audit-check.py 312 --tree`)
- [ ] Given the two open bugs (#228, #250), when they are audited, then each
      is either still reproducible with evidence, or closed with proof
      (manual: drive the reported path on the running stack)

## Definition of Ready
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 5

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Bugs sit outside the Epic to Story to Task hierarchy by design, so no
per-epic story under #251 reaches them. This story is how they get audited.

11 of 13 are closed. #228 and #250 are open.

Severity and Priority are separate axes. A closed bug whose body states a
priority that disagrees with its label is a finding, not a formatting nit.
